summary: Assign permissions to groups and put users in them rather than granting per user. Automation hub teams range from admins governing collections to content uploaders, and view-only access (enabled in the installer inventory) lets people view or download hub collections and namespaces without logging in.
questions: How do I enable view-only access on private automation hub?
Can users browse automation hub without logging in?
Should I assign AAP permissions to groups or users?
